headline: Federal executive departments and agencies close for half a day on Tuesday, December 24, 2002, Christmas Eve.
what_it_does: This order closes federal executive departments and agencies for half of the workday on Tuesday, December 24, 2002. The title does not say which half of the day or whether any offices must stay open. No other details are available from the source.

who_it_affects.how: Many get half of the workday off on December 24, 2002.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices may be closed or have shorter hours for part of December 24, 2002.
